🚨 Traffic Advisory – Kothur Y-Junction Underpass 🚨
Due to heavy rainfall yesterday, the Kothur Y-Junction underpass is waterlogged. Dewatering operations are in progress with motors, and two additional motors are being arranged with the support of NH-44 authorities.

Traffic Diversion: Vehicles are being diverted via Penjarla X-road. Motorists are advised to plan their routes accordingly and drive with caution in the area.

CYBERABAD TRAFFIC POLICE.
